comment: The panel prints LEVEL on the four operator level knobs, while configParam at src/FourV2/FourV2.cpp:241 names them Op N Output and the README calls the control OUTPUT; the panel is followed in the line and the disagreement named there. The panel SVG carries the operator artwork but the lettering is drawn in code by FourV2PanelLabels at src/FourV2/FourV2.cpp:516, which prints Four V2, ALGO, TUNE, PM DEPTH, MASTER, EXT PM, V/OCT, MAIN OUT, OP1 to OP4, COARSE, MODE, FINE, FOLD TYPE, LEVEL, WARP, FOLD and FEEDBACK. The OVER lamp is configLight-named OVER at src/FourV2/FourV2.cpp:304 but no OVER lettering is drawn; it is an unlabelled red lamp under MAIN OUT, and lights cannot be clicked for help, so it is covered by a Note. All 54 parameters have widgets, unlike Four. Ratio mode snaps the continuous 0..14 COARSE value to one of the fifteen ratios in src/FourV2/model.h:33; fixed mode maps the same 0..14 exponentially to expf(coarse/14 * ln 10000), which is 1Hz at the left and 10000Hz at the right (src/FourV2/model.h:89). No module has a panel context menu anywhere in this plugin.
